title: ChronoCulture: Evaluating Cultural Awareness Across Time in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs to predict the distribution of survey responses for specific countries and comparing them against ground truth data from international social surveys to identify disparities in representation, such as higher accuracy for Western countries compared to non-Western populations.

Comparing model-predicted survey response distributions for the same questions and countries across older and newer years to measure the models' ability to capture evolving cultural attitudes and social norms over time.
